scope: in-process synchronous ideal-peer simulation; NOT live P2P/WebRTC

fairness.peer_optimizer: persistent adamw moments and loha factors within each refresh cycle; reset every 4 rounds (0=off)
fairness.central_optimizer_refresh: central LoHa factors merged to frozen base, then factors and optimizer restarted at same cadence
fairness.training_sample_order: central round-robin across peers; P2P local order by peer
fairness.peer_aggregation: FedSum: SUM of effective deltas, no division by peers
fairness.sampling: no replacement across rounds until each peer dataset exhausted
fairness.scheduler: per-arm fractional-progress linear warmup and cosine decay
fairness.compute_time_rule: sum(sequentially measured peer training seconds) / peers
fairness.caveat: dividing by peers ASSUMES perfectly parallel equal-speed devices; not measured wall time. Max-per-round is an alternative lower-bound estimate; communication excluded.

limitations: No actual network or churn; not a Fedpara signed-event Gossip benchmark.
FedSum is an intentionally stronger update than FedAvg: effective update magnitude can grow with the number of peers; divergence is possible.
Random TinyStories-1M has a FROZEN random base: only LoHa/LoRA learns, with continual before/after factor deltas merged into the base each synchronization round.
Live asynchronous gossip does not use this offline benchmark synchronization barrier.
Live reset is per signed LOCAL publish count; offline reset is per synchronous round. Not identical time intervals.
Compute / peers is idealized; data loading, evaluation, model cloning and communication overhead excluded.
